thread:
Maya: Hey team — draft for the product launch blog is up: <https://drive.redwood/example-draft|product-launch-draft>. Need quick pass on: benchmark numbers (Owen), hero visual (Sasha), webinar CTA + HS mapping (Liam). Can we lock by EOD?
Owen: on it. Quick Q — can we tighten the benchmark claim around cost-per-token? current phrasing feels broad.
Maya: good call. I can replace '30-50% lower' with the specific numbers from the optimize study. Draft snippet I propose: `30% median token-cost reduction on streaming workloads, 45% at 8k seq when using prefix caching + quantized pipeline` — does that read ok?
Owen: yes — that phrasing is better. Add a short footnote referencing the internal benchmarking doc (link) so legal has context.
Sasha: saw the hero wireframe. Prefer option B (the interactive KPI panel). Can we get a final export by 2pm? I need the SVG and a dark-mode variant.
Maya: putting Sasha as owner for visuals. @Sasha will drop files to the folder and I'll update the draft.
Liam: for CTA and HS mapping — recommend: webinar reg -> HS form "Launch Webinar - Signup" tag: `launch_webinar_2026`; then post-reg nurture path = "Launch - Webinar Attendees" list. Quick mapping below:
```
HubSpot form: Launch Webinar - Signup -> Workflow: Webinar Confirm -> List: launch_webinar_attendees -> Lead score + assign
CTA button: "Save My Seat" -> UTM: campaign=launch_q2
```
Maya: perfect. Can you confirm the form slug and if we need an extra hidden field for account-tier? Also, which team owns post-reg email copy?
Liam: form slug is `launch_webinar_signup_2026`. Add hidden `account_tier` field. Growth will own post-reg emails, cc @Noah for cadence.
Noah: I can take cadence. Suggest: immediate confirm, 48h reminder, 24h final + nurture 3 days after. Will draft and share in /marketing/email-assets.
LaunchBot: Reminder set: final approval sync at 16:00 today — participants: Maya, Owen, Sasha, Liam, Noah.
Maya: thanks all. I'll update the draft with the tightened benchmark language, add Sasha's hero when available, and drop a publishing checklist in the folder. Locking copy at 16:00 unless there are blockers. :thumbsup:
Noah: thumbs up from me. Small ask — can we add a one-line blurb about Dedicated (reserved capacity) benefits in the second section? good for enterprise readers.
Maya: noted. I'll add a short para and ping legal for a quick check. If anyone sees anything urgent, flag in thread.
